description: This file defines a React-like component named 'Home' using the Blits component framework. It manages the state related to notes, interacts with a store for data persistence, and renders the main layout including navigation, notes list, editor, and empty state components.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Blits component representing the main page, managing notes display and editing interface.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the component's notesCount state with the number of notes in the store.
